protocol.scope: subcategory_extraction only; not a full 100-point competition result
protocol.duplicate_policy: identical inputs inferred once; every reference row scored

limitations: Automatically relabeled provisional dataset; not independently verified manual gold.
Reviewed test is diagnostic, not an independent holdout.
Test source mcId is missing; 101 is an explicit assumption.
Original guided prompts unchanged; no prompt or threshold tuning on reviewed test.
Metrics cannot be directly compared with old208-row results.

nearest_train_cosine.method: joint unsupervised char_wb TFIDF (3,5), min_df1, max_features60000, sublinear_tf=True; cosine nearest train per test

tokenization.normalization: NFKC; collapse whitespace; preserve case and ё
tokenization.pooling: mean over all attention-masked tokens of real windows, including special tokens
tokenization.padding: longest real window in document batch

training.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss; unweighted mean over documents and classes

encoder_report.evaluation: No validation/holdout/test; all supplied training rows used in all epochs

metadata.provenance: genuine recorded API probabilities; exact input/source replay, not fresh calls; labels not reused

costs.scope: external API token charges only; not invoices or local compute

latency_seconds.scope: single unique input; includes first inference; excludes pipeline loading

training.selection_metric: validation micro-F1 at 0.5, excluding source category 101

search.global: Точный перебор уникальных score; равные score переключаются атомарно
search.tie_preference: Исходный порог, затем 0.5, близость к 0.5, больший порог

per_category.objective: Общий micro-F1, не среднее по категориям
per_category.acceptance: Только строгое улучшение, точное сравнение дробей

search.zero_positive_policy: Без отдельной настройки; сохранён global (в fixed — 0.5)

calibration.selection_data: validation only; no control/public-test scores or labels
